description: SAWS-ASPECS combines forecasts of solar flares, energetic-particle occurrence and proton-event characteristics. Its warning-system development is directed toward spacecraft and launch-operator requirements. The resource is documented by National Observatory of Athens. The documented physical domain is Solar, Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Continuous/RT Run (ISWA data tree), Continuous/RT Run (SEP Scoreboard Intensity), Continuous/RT Run (SEP Scoreboard Probability). A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The page describes a development activity; it does not establish achieved performance against every operator requirement. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded.
